entries.title: Psalms 70:3
segments:
Aha; an expression of contemptuous exultation. 
 
The end of all who persist in persecuting God's servants, shall be "shame and everlasting contempt."  But they who seek God in sincerity and truth shall be, through grace, rewarded with everlasting glory and blessedness.

entries.title: Psalms 70:5
segments: The unworthiness and poverty of sinners forms no barrier against their acceptance with God; when their wants are duly felt, and they apply to God for help, he is glorified in bestowing it upon them.
